messages:
oncall-aaron: ops-bot started canary rollout to edge pool 'blue-wave' at 12:19 UTC, monitoring
ops-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for rollout group 'blue-wave' — 5xx=18% over 2m, probe failures increasing
oncall-aaron: seeing the spike in dashboards, latency up ~200ms. paging eng-sre and infra
maya: i have the pager, joining now
leo: joining — which model and pool?
oncall-aaron: model=v2-quant, pool=us-east-g4, traffic=20% split. ramping over last 5m
infra-jess: grabbing logs, appears repeated conn resets to backend: ```[2026-03-17T12:20:34Z] ERR 503 downstream conn reset /inference pid=4321```
sam: quick mitigation path: flip rollout-split -> 0% feature flag and fallback route to model-v1
maya: agree. that should stop user impact immediately. ready to coordinate toggle
leo: also recommend triggering route-level fallback=true so existing sessions degrade to model-v1 rather than fail
oncall-aaron: performing both in console now
oncall-aaron: toggled feature flag rollback: rollout-split=0% — :white_check_mark:
oncall-aaron: enabled route fallback to model-v1 — :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: NOTICE: rollback invoked by oncall-aaron at 2026-03-17T12:22:05Z
ops-bot: HEALTHCHECK: 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% within 90s of rollback
maya: customer impact summary? support looking into error spikes
sam: support logs show ~120 requests returned 503 across 2 tenants between 12:19–12:22 UTC, likely transient; opening support tickets for those customers
infra-jess: correlating with nodepool rolling kernel upgrade on the same workers — seeing CPU steal and socket timeouts during that window
leo: created infra ticket INF-1542: investigate nodepool kernel upgrade + inference runtime interaction
oncall-aaron: handing off to eng-sre and infra to own RCA. @eng-sre please take over the channel for follow-up
maya: i'll prepare customer-facing note and incident stub. recommend adding 'health-check ramp gate' to rollout policy as an action item
ops-bot: Pager cleared — incident mitigated (duration ~3m).
sam: proposed action items: 1) revert recent kernel build on the impacted nodepool; 2) add gating to rollouts (healthcheck+error-rate) to block beyond 5% 5xx; 3) add alert for KVCACHE OOM and sustained conn resets on quantized models
infra-jess: will schedule rollback of kernel build to yesterday's stable image and run soak tests
leo: assigning INF-1542 to infra-jess, tagging eng-runtime
oncall-aaron: noting no SLA breach per current telemetry but we should treat this as high-severity near miss; support will reach out to affected customers proactively
maya: will draft postmortem and customer communication, pinging for review in #eng-releases and #support
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout record updated — aborted by oncall-aaron at 12:22:05 UTC, final split 0%
eng-sre: ack, taking handoff. will update when we have root cause and mitigation timeline
oncall-aaron: thanks all for quick response. closing this thread — please continue follow-ups under INF-1542 and the incident doc
oncall-aaron: :v:
